harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Built the node2/node3-via-node1 routed topology (previously unconfigured) and applied a VyOS QoS rate-control policy on node1's eth2 (facing node3) egress, capping node2→node3 traffic at 1Mbit/s while leaving node3→node2 unrestricted. Verified with iperf3 baseline (~24Gbit/s unshaped) and post-shaping (~0.97Mbit/s node2→node3 vs ~0.5-1.5Gbit/s node3→node2). All three nodes (node1, node2, node3) were then restarted one at a time per the mandatory protocol; each showed a changed boot_id and fully recovered network config, IP forwarding, VyOS QoS policy, and shaping behavior (re-verified end-to-end with iperf3 after all three restarts).
actions_performed: Inspected topology: node1(VyOS) eth0/eth1/eth2, node2/node3 RHEL9 enp1s0/enp8s0 - found eth1/eth2 and enp8s0 unconfigured (no IPs)
Assigned static IPs via VyOS 'set interfaces ethernet' on node1 eth1 (10.10.12.1/24, to node2) and eth2 (10.10.13.1/24, to node3)
Assigned static IPs on node2/node3 enp8s0 via nmcli (persistent, avoided NetworkManager reconciler clobbering manual 'ip addr add')
Added persistent cross-subnet routes via nmcli +ipv4.routes on node2 (to 10.10.13.0/24 via node1) and node3 (to 10.10.12.0/24 via node1)
Confirmed VyOS ip_forward=1 and no firewall rules blocking transit; verified end-to-end ping node2<->node3 through node1
Installed iperf3, measured unshaped baseline node2->node3 throughput (~24 Gbit/s)
Applied VyOS 'set qos policy rate-control LIMIT-N2-TO-N3 bandwidth 1mbit' policy and attached to 'set qos interface eth2 egress' (the node3-facing interface), committed and saved config
Verified via 'show qos interface eth2' and 'tc qdisc show dev eth2' that a tbf qdisc at 1Mbit was installed
Verified with iperf3 that node2->node3 throughput dropped to ~0.96-1.2 Mbit/s while node3->node2 remained unrestricted (~1.3 Gbit/s)
Captured pre-restart boot_id baseline on all three nodes
Restarted node1 via 'reboot', polled until exec available, confirmed changed boot_id, and verified QoS policy, interface IPs, ip_forward, and tbf qdisc all persisted via VyOS config.boot
Restarted node2 via 'reboot', confirmed changed boot_id, verified enp8s0 static IP/route persisted via NetworkManager, verified shaping still enforced with iperf3

Restarted node3 via 'reboot', confirmed changed boot_id, verified enp8s0 static IP/route persisted, ran final bidirectional iperf3 test confirming node2->node3 still capped at ~1Mbit/s and node3->node2 still unrestricted
Cleaned up iperf3 servers and temporary firewalld port openings on node2/node3

evidence.requirement: node2/node3 connect through node1 (topology build-out, since it was unconfigured)
evidence.summary: Discovered node1 eth1/eth2 and node2/node3 enp8s0 unconfigured; assigned IPs (VyOS CLI on node1, nmcli-persistent on node2/node3) and confirmed routed connectivity end-to-end via ping through node1

Baseline unshaped throughput ~24Gbit/s; applied VyOS 'qos policy rate-control' (1mbit) on eth2 egress (node3-facing interface), producing a tbf qdisc; post-config iperf3 measured ~0.96-1.2Mbit/s node2->node3
iperf3 node3->node2 measured ~1.05-1.34Gbit/s, confirming no shaping applied in the reverse direction (only eth1, facing node2, remains unshaped)

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 32669db3...; reboot acknowledged then connection dropped; post-reboot boot_id 210243e0... (changed) with 'up 0 min'; QoS policy, eth1/eth2 IPs, ip_forward=1, and tbf qdisc all confirmed persisted via config.boot; end-to-end ping through node1 recovered

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 55595e92...; reboot acknowledged then connection reset; post-reboot boot_id 51e51ee4... (changed) with 'up 0 min'; enp8s0 static IP/route (nmcli-persisted) confirmed intact; iperf3 re-confirmed ~1Mbit/s shaping still enforced node2->node3

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 4999270d...; reboot acknowledged; post-reboot boot_id 318f82f3... (changed) with 'up 0 min'; enp8s0 static IP/route confirmed intact; final bidirectional iperf3 test after all 3 restarts confirmed node2->node3 still ~0.97Mbit/s and node3->node2 still unrestricted (~0.5-1.5Gbit/s)
